items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 May 2026 8:50am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 23 May 2026 at 8:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic, while high pressure covers mainland Europe, with another high centre developing off the southwest of England today.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest this afternoon and occasionally touching 5 in places, but falling variable 3 or less in the southeast. Becoming Southerly 2 to 4 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate for a time this evening and overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist or fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor in any mist, or very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, becoming variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area tomorrow morning, decreasing South or Southeast 2 or 3 in all waters overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but a risk of mist or fog patches in places.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor in any mist, or very poor in fog patches.
